name: Video to GIF Maker: Gifspool
subtitle: Trim, Caption, Under 8 MB
shortDescription: Make a GIF from a video or photos. Trim, caption and export a GIF that fits your size limit.
longDescription:
Make a GIF from a video or photos on your iPhone or iPad. Trim, set speed and loop, crop, add a caption and stickers, then export a GIF that fits your limit.

### Fits Your Limit
Pick 1 MB, 8 MB or 25 MB and Gifspool lowers frame rate, size and colours step by step until it fits. A live preview with a size meter shows the result before you save.

### Editing
Reverse and boomerang, simple filters, MP4 export, share or save.

### Private
Everything happens on your device; no account, files never uploaded.

Free with 2 starting credits and short rewarded ads for more, or go ad-free with a monthly plan.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
